conditions: Keep the last-resort fallback per caller: decode_bytes(data, fallback=...) with utf-8 errors='replace' for EasyVista tickets and latin-1 for documents. Otherwise accept the regression below explicitly.
corrections: The finder understates the difference. The last fallback is reached when a file is neither valid UTF-8 nor cp1252, i.e. it contains 0x81/0x8D/0x8F/0x90/0x9D. That is typically a UTF-8 export with one stray byte, since those bytes occur as UTF-8 continuation bytes, e.g. Á=C3 81, Í=C3 8D, Ł=C5 81. In that case the whole file decodes differently. latin-1 turns every multibyte character into mojibake ('N° de ticket' -> 'NÂ° de ticket'), so tickets.scrub no longer finds the ticket-id header and skips every row. Accented kept columns are lost, and person columns ('Bénéficiaire', …) are no longer recognised, though they still drop as unknown columns. utf-8 errors='replace' loses only the stray byte.
